entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number to pull up your account?

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. You received the VeloBand GPS Tracker about 9 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, I don't have time to play twenty questions. The pulse reader is garbage and gives readings that are all over the place. I just want money back for it.
I understand your frustration with the readings. We can definitely troubleshoot that to...
No. I don't want to troubleshoot. I'm busy, and I need a simple yes or no. Can you process a refund or not?
Okay, I hear you. One moment while I review the return eligibility for your order.

Alright, I've checked the policy. It looks like all our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it just 9 days ago, you're unfortunately outside that window. I cannot approve this return for a full refund.
Great. Finally. What do I need to do?

I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
